pitches.logline: Gio drives out to buy his first car but is stuck behind a slow carrier stacked with cars. He yells at it, and the twist says money from car re-exports fell 24%. The VIN scanner then checks the car he wants.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: the carrier brakes in front of him, Gio leans on the horn and yells out of the window
pitches.heroObject: the car carrier blocking the road

pitches.logline: A Saburtalo taxi driver idles his diesel outside a block for a passenger who said two minutes half an hour ago. The twist: diesel went past 5 lari. The navigator then gets them there with no extra laps.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: the driver slams the horn at the dark entrance, a light flicks on upstairs and off again

pitches.logline: Nino circles Vera's narrow streets for a parking spot while the fuel light comes on. The twist: at Bathurst the leader ran out of fuel on the last lap. The parking page ends the circling.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: Nino slows for a gap that is a driveway; the driver behind blasts his horn

treatment.logline: Gio, on his way to buy his first car, is stuck behind a car carrier and late for the seller; he yells at the carrier, the news says car re-exports brought 24% less money, and the VIN scanner reads the car he is buying.
treatment.hero: Gio, a first-time buyer in his car on the road
treatment.obstacle: a slow car carrier blocking the road while the seller waits
treatment.heroObject: the car carrier blocking the road

hook.event: frame 0: the carrier blocks the road at night, Gio leans on the horn

act1: the carrier crawls and blocks the lane: the clock reads 18:40
still stuck: 18:47, the seller is waiting
a dead stop: 18:55, Gio leans out and yells at the carrier's driver, „გადამყიდველო“, one bleep
treatment.turn: the shout freezes over the photo of the lot full of cars, the marker under „გადამყიდველო“, a 0.6 s hold

reveal.what: NewsCard: Geostat, 19 October 2026: car re-exports brought 24% less money in January to September, $1.5 billion; then the stat card

screens.step: tap გადაღება and photograph the VIN

treatment.payoff: Gio, still behind the carrier, photographs the VIN of the car he is buying and the app reads it at once
treatment.signature: the late clock rolling over the jam photo, ringed on the third jump
